latvia.description: Mis saab teie majast, kui talvel kaob elekter terveks ööpäevaks? Harkivi 21-korruselise elamu elanikud on leidnud viisi, kuidas hoida pikema elektrikatkestuse ajal töös küte, veevarustus ja liftid. Ukraina korteriomanike ühenduste kogemusest võib kasu olla ka Eesti elanikele.

latvia.title: Sylvester Stallone tülist Arnold Schwarzeneggeriga: see oli väga karm, aga mulle meeldis!
latvia.description: Sylvester Stallone rääkis uues podcast’is avameelselt sellest, kuidas sai alguse tema pikka aega kestnud tüli Arnold Schwarzeneggeriga. Ühel hetkel suudeti aga ära leppida, sest omavaheline konkurents filmimaailma polnud enam suur.

latvia.title: Mihkelson: uut Teherani või Jalta lepet ei tule
latvia.description: Kui USA president Donald Trump viitas võimalusele sõlmida Venemaaga suur kokkulepe, mis puudutab lisaks Ukraina sõja lõpetamisele ka kogu Euroopa julgeolekut, siis riigikogu väliskomisjoni esimehe Marko Mihkelsoni arvates seda ei juhtu.

latvia.title: Latvian government judges itself to have done pretty well
latvia.description: On November 6th, 2026, the Cabinet of Ministers reviewed a report prepared by the State Chancellery on the implementation of the action plan of the government led by Andris Kulbergs. According to its findnings, by October 15th, 2026, 52 out of 61 priority ministerial tasks, or 85%, had been completed, as well as 132 or 71% of the total 185 measures included in the government action plan.

latvia.title: Workers offered chance to improve Latvian language skills
latvia.description: In order to promote the competitiveness of employees and facilitate their inclusion in the work environment, the State Employment Agency (NVA) will offer the opportunity to acquire or improve Latvian language skills free of charge within the framework of the lifelong learning activities of the European Social Fund Plus (ESF+) project “Support for Adult Education”.

latvia.title: Contraband cigs thrown from moving train in Latvia
latvia.description: On 4 November, the State Police detained two Belarusian nationals – a train driver and his assistant – on suspicion of large-scale smuggling. The men threw several packets of illegal cigarettes from a moving train.

latvia.title: Average Latvian salaries are lowest in the Baltics
latvia.description: In 2025, the average annual full-time adjusted salary for employees in the EU was €41 500, reflecting a 4.3% increase from €39 800 in 2024, according to Eurostat data published on November 6th.

latvia.title: Latvia discusses electronic warfare with partners willing to help Ukraine
latvia.description: This week, a plenary session of the Electronic Warfare Coalition took place in Latvia, during which coalition representatives discussed current challenges in the field of electronic warfare, as well as the necessary support for Ukraine to strengthen this capability.

latvia.title: Nepal declines Latvian humanitarian aid
latvia.description: Nepal, which was hit by devastating floods at the end of August, has declined the humanitarian aid offered by Latvia, which had been prepared by the Emergency Medical Service (NMPD) and the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD), and consequently, on Friday 6 November, the government revoked the order to provide humanitarian aid to Nepal.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Porta, Patriotic Walk, Belts
latvia.description: The Month of Patriots has begun in Latvia. What will it be this weekend?

latvia.title: Rīga Book Festival starts today
latvia.description: On November 6th and 7th, the traditional Riga Book Festival will offer a rich programme at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia's influenza vaccination rate low, death rate high by EU standards
latvia.description: Fresh Eurostat data for 2023 and 2024 show that Latvia had one of the lowest rates of influenza vaccination and one of the highest rates of death from influenza.

latvia.title: Latvian public invited to mark Lāčplēsis Day on November 11th
latvia.description: On Lāčplēsis Day (November 11th), commemorative events will be held throughout Latvia, with the participation of soldiers of the National Armed Forces and allies.

latvia.title: Fuel prices up 34% on year in Latvia
latvia.description: Data published by Central Statistical Bureau on November 5 show that, compared with October 2025, the average level of consumer prices for fuels for transport in October 2026 was 34.5 % higher. Diesel prices increased by 38.1 %, petrol prices by 27.9 % and auto gas prices by 12.9 %.

latvia.title: Mārupe, Daugavpils named most business-friendly areas in Latvia
latvia.description: Mārupe Municipality has been recognised as the most business-friendly municipality, whilst Daugavpils has been awarded the status of the most business-friendly city, according to the Latvian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (LTRK).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 5th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: New Saeima deputies start to settle in
latvia.description: After being sworn in earlier this week, Latvia's Saeima deputies are starting to settle in – but that comes with several challenges.

latvia.title: Latvia's 2027 Michelin Guide has 35 restaurants
latvia.description: In the fourth year of the Latvian ‘Michelin’ Guide, a further 12 Latvian restaurants have been added to the selection, according to Michelin.

latvia.title: 14th Saeima's top speakers revealed
latvia.description: Over the past four years, the 14th Saeima adopted a total of 1,078 laws - 140 new ones and 938 amendments to existing laws according to a summary of the activities of the 100 Saeima deputies.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvian Foreign Minister speaks at NATO command centre
latvia.description: Latvia's Foreign Minister Baiba Braže was in the Netherlands on November 4th at NATO’s Allied Joint Force Command Brunssum and participated in an informal meeting of foreign ministers.

latvia.title: Over half of Latvia's internet users also use AI
latvia.description: According to the annual Central Statistical Bureau survey on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) in households and by individuals, published on November 5, 58.2 % of internet users in Latvia used generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools in 2026, 23.1 percentage points more than a year earlier.

latvia.title: Major drug bust in Rīga's woods
latvia.description: On 21 October this year, the State Police seized approximately 36 kilograms of various drugs in Rīga, Jūrmala and the surrounding area, the majority of which had been hidden in barrels buried in the ground in the woods. A group of six people has been arrested on suspicion of drug trafficking, the police said.

latvia.title: Dozens more illegal crossings prevented on Latvia-Belarus border
latvia.description: On Wednesday, November 4th, State Border Guard officers prevented 22 people from illegally crossing the Latvian-Belarusian state border, according to the border guard's own figures.

latvia.title: New Rīga city councillors take up their seats
latvia.description: At the Riga City Council meeting on Thursday, November 5th, 13 new deputies were approved – a knock-on effect of the recent parliamentary elections which saw numerous Rīga city councillors elected as Saeima deputies.

latvia.title: New Saeima deputy in trouble on day one
latvia.description: A newly-elected member of Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, has found himself in hot water on his very first day in the job.

latvia.title: Rīga to look for budget savings for next year
latvia.description: Next year, Riga will have to contribute 24 million euros more to the municipal equalisation fund than this year, so Riga City Council will be looking for ways to make savings, as confirmed by Riga’s Deputy Mayor Vilnis Ķirsis (New Unity) on the Latvian Television programme ‘Morning Panorama’ on November 5.

latvia.title: Rīga outlines November celebration plans
latvia.description: During the upcoming week from Lāčplēsis Day (November 11) to the 108th anniversary of the proclamation of the Republic of Latvia (November 18), the Rīga Municipality is inviting residents and visitors to various events in the capital.

latvia.title: Experts ponder why some foods are expensive in Latvia
latvia.description: Why are oils and fats in Latvia the second most expensive in the European Union (EU), after Switzerland? This was one of the issues discussed by economists, industry representatives and experts at a debate organised by the Competition Council (KP) on Wednesday, 4 November, Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Smiltene decides to lock doors of gambling halls
latvia.description: Gambling venues that have been operating in Smiltene for more than 20 years could disappear from the town by 2031. Following the district council’s decision to close two gambling halls, the law stipulates that they will have to cease operations in five years’ time, provided the gambling operators do not challenge this decision, Latvian Television reported on November 4.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Experts offer crisis situation advice to Latvian public
latvia.description: What to discuss with children and what medicines to prepare for a crisis situation – representatives of emergency services and other experts shared various recommendations to improve the preparedness of residents in crisis situations during a discussion on Latvian Television on Wednesday, November 4th.

latvia.title: Use of AI gradually increasing among Latvian businesses
latvia.description: In 2026, 18.5 % of companies in Latvia will be using artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, 6.3 percentage points more than in 2025, according to the Central Statistical Bureau's annual survey on the use of information and communication technologies (ICT) and e-commerce.

latvia.title: Shortage of flu vaccines in Latvia
latvia.description: There is still a shortage of flu vaccines in Latvia for both children and adults. GPs point out that neither state-funded nor private flu vaccines are currently available. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has indicated that vaccine deliveries to Latvia should take place in the coming weeks, Latvian Radio reported on November 4.

latvia.title: Police drills to take place at Rīga Central Station at night
latvia.description: On the night of 4 to 5 November, a crisis simulation exercise organised by the State Police in collaboration with the state-owned company “Latvian Railways” and the passenger rail operator Vivi will take place at Riga Central Railway Station.

latvia.title: Industrial output slightly up on year in Latvia
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau calendar-adjusted data at constant prices, published November 4, show that in September 2026 industrial production output increased by 2.6 % year on year.

latvia.title: Latvia approved for EUR 500m payment by European Commission
latvia.description: On Wednesday, 4th November, Latvia received the green light from the European Commission (EC) for the fifth and final payment request of EUR 503.7 million from the Recovery Fund (RF), the Latvian Finance Ministry confirmed.

latvia.title: Paradoxical port: Liepāja's Karosta prepares for reborn role
latvia.description: Once sealed off from the public and shrouded in secrecy, Karosta will become one of the main stages of Liepāja’s year as European Capital of Culture in 2027. The former military port is a unique part of the coastal city – a place where Latvia’s turbulent history, monumental architecture, the Baltic Sea and a new creative life exist side by side.

latvia.title: Life in Rīga down the drain
latvia.description: What can you learn about the habits of Rīga residents by looking into their sewers? Perhaps too much, according to Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Rinkēvičs officially nominates Kulbergs for Prime Minister
latvia.description: On Wednesday, 4 November, President Edgars Rinkēvičs officially nominated Andris Kulbergs, leader of the United List, for the post of Prime Minister.

latvia.title: Kulbergs says government proposal will be ready by November 18
latvia.description: Andris Kulbergs (United List), whom the President asked in October to form a government, remains determined to present his proposal for a government by the national holiday, November 18, he said in an interview with Latvian Television's

latvia.title: Saeima won't bother with Russia, Belarus parliamentary cooperation groups
latvia.description: On Tuesday, November 3, the 15th Saeima decided at an extraordinary session not to form parliamentary groups to promote cooperation with the parliaments of Russia and Belarus in this parliamentary term, confirming Latvia's unwavering support for Ukraine and solidarity with its people.

latvia.title: Latvian students determined to find mummies
latvia.description: In Latvia, we cannot boast of having mummies or tombs, but the study of mummified human remains buried here can still provide unique insights into the diseases, lifestyles, living conditions and much more of the period in question. Medical students at Riga Stradiņš University (RSU) have set out to identify mummified remains in Latvia and study them using modern methods, according to the Latvian Radio programme ‘Zināmais nezināmajā’.

latvia.title: Ice possible on roads around Rīga Wednesday morning
latvia.description: On Wednesday morning, ice in the Rīga area is making driving conditions difficult on the country’s main roads. Anti-skid materials are being spread on slippery sections of the road, said Latvian State Roads (LVC).

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd November, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian hockey teams will still not play against Russia
latvia.description: The governing body for ice hockey in Latvia said on November 3rd that Latvian teams will not play against Russia, despite attempts by Russia to force its way back into International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) competitions.

latvia.title: More details released about recent drone incidents in Latvia
latvia.description: On November 3rd, Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) provided some additional details of two recent drone incursions, though full accounts of what the drones were and where they ended up remain elusive.

latvia.title: Edvards Smiltēns returns as Saeima Speaker
latvia.description: Politician Edvards Smiltēns (United List) was elected as the Speaker of the 15th Saeima on November 3rd, marking a return to the position he lost just over three years ago.

latvia.title: President Edgars Rinkēvičs' opening speech to the 15th Saeima
latvia.description: On Tuesday, November 3rd, the first sitting of the 15th Saeima (parliament) took place in Rīga. Proceedings were kicked off by President Edgars Rinkēvičs, who addressed the newly-assembled deputies with the speech below [Please note this is an unofficial translation. We'll update it with an official translation if one appears].

latvia.title: Man detained in central Rīga on suspicion of selling drugs in broad daylight
latvia.description: On 23 October, shortly before 1.00 pm, the attention of staff at the Rīga City Council Municipal Police CCTV centre was drawn to a group of people in Vērmane Park, one of whom was allegedly dealing in narcotic substances.

latvia.title: WATCH: Latvia lays out its plans for the United Nations Security Council
latvia.description: Latvia takes the helm of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) throughout November, the first time ever that it has had that responsibility.

latvia.title: Latvia signs up to European Defence Alliance in Paris
latvia.description: Latvia joined the European Defence Alliance in Paris on November 2nd to expand cooperation between Latvian defence industry companies and European partners.

latvia.title: 'Baltic Fraud Lab' is coming in December
latvia.description: On December 17th, Rīga will host what is described as "the first ever practical fraud and corruption risk investigation laboratory in Latvia – BALTIC FRAUD LAB 2026."

latvia.title: RSU to host Innovation Day this week
latvia.description: On 5th November, from 09:00 to 17:00, Rīga Stradiņš University (RSU) will be hosting Innovation Day, inviting visitors to discover entrepreneurial experiences, emerging technologies and research solutions for healthcare and sport.

lithuania.title: French far left enshrines leaving NATO in official presidential platform
lithuania.description: Polls show Jean-Luc Mélenchon could reach the French presidential election's second round next year.

lithuania.title: FIREPOWER: Nordic defence giants push joint initiatives
lithuania.description: In today's edition: NATO, Finnish nuclear policy, Ukraine loan

lithuania.title: NATO hosts second Brussels talks on Ukraine security guarantees
lithuania.description: The talks focused on possible security guarantees, Ukraine's representative said

lithuania.title: EU, NATO split roles in Brussels talks on Ukraine
lithuania.description: A two-track structure emerges for EU-US-NATO ahead of next week's Abu Dhabi summit

lithuania.title: Három utasszállítót is bombafenyegetés ért, riasztották a magyar Gripeneket
lithuania.description: Sorban jöttek a NATO-riasztások, a magyar vadászgépeknek, miután kikísérték a repülőket a légtérből, légi járőrözést rendeltek el.

lithuania.title: A világ legveszélyesebb vize nem a Perzsa-öböl, és nem csak az olajkereskedelem bedőléséből lehet óriási krízis
lithuania.description: Nyár óta sokkal több támadás éri a hajókat a Fekete-tengeren, mint a Hormuzi-szoros környékén, és a csapások is jóval több áldozatot szednek. Az orosz–ukrán háború fokozódik ezen a fronton is, egyre több kereskedőhajót ér dróntalálat Románia és Bulgária partjainál. A világ jelentős részét élelmező orosz és ukrán gabonaexport lassan ellehetetlenül, miközben szakértők szerint Moszkva a NATO tűrőképességét teszteli. Könnyen lehet, hogy olajkrízis helyett rövidesen mindenki mezőgazdasági és élelmezési válságról fog beszélni.

lithuania.title: Néhány órán belül háromszor riasztotta a NATO a magyar Gripeneket utasszállító repülőket érintő bombafenyegetés miatt
lithuania.description: Korábban sosem tapasztalt mértékű bombafenyegetések érték az európai légiközlekedést. A fenyegetések egy része telefonon vagy e-mailben érkezett, de volt, hogy a repülőgép mosdójának tükrére írták rá, hogy „bomba”. Az oroszok, Irán vagy egy nőgyűlölő szervezet áll a fenyegetések mögött?

lithuania.title: Meghalt Jay Rockefeller, a milliárdos dinasztia örököse, aki a szegényekért harcolt Amerikában
lithuania.description: 89 éves volt.

lithuania.title: Néhány órán belül három, bombával fenyegetett utasszállítóhoz is riasztották a magyar Gripeneket
lithuania.description: A NATO is intézkedett.

lithuania.title: Nyíltan bejelentette a francia elnökjelölt: a választás után kilépne Franciaország a NATO-ból
lithuania.description: Közzétette hivatalos választási programját a Jean-Luc Mélenchon vezette Engedetlen Franciaország (LFI). A radikális baloldali párt fokozatosan kivezetné az országot a NATO-ból, államosítaná a legfontosabb védelmi ipari vállalatokat, az ukrajnai háborút pedig diplomáciai úton zárná le - jelentette a Politico.

lithuania.title: Magas szintről jött a figyelmeztetés: egyre közelebb a legrosszabb forgatókönyv, a NATO aktiválhatja az 5. cikkelyt
lithuania.description: A lengyel Onet számolt be Gitanas Nausėda litván elnök kijelentéséről, aki szerint egyre nagyobb nyomás nehezedik a NATO-ra.

lithuania.title: Kiadta a NATO Magyarországra az ALPHA-riasztást: akcióba léptek a magyar légierő Gripenjei
lithuania.description: Háromszor is riasztották a magyar légierő Gripen vadászbombázóit - adja hírül Ruszin-Szendi Romulusz honvédelmi miniszter Facebookon.

lithuania.title: Arabov nadchlo, že prvý moslimský senátor oslovil JD Vancea „habibi“, pridal aj ďalšie výrazy
lithuania.description: Arabi naprieč svetom oslavujú volebné víťazstvo ľavicového demokrata Abdula El-Sayeda v Michigane, napísala dnes agentúra AP. Pozornosť vzbudil predovšetkým moment z jeho víťazného prejavu, v ktorom moslimský politik a zvolený senátor oslovil amerického viceprezidenta J.D. Vancea arabským výrazom "habibi", teda môj priateľovi či môj drahý alebo kamoš.

lithuania.title: Zomrel niekdajší americký senátor Jay Rockefeller, člen slávnej dynastie
lithuania.description: Vo veku 89 rokov zomrel niekdajší demokratický senátor za Západnú Virgíniu Jay Rockefeller, ktorý bol členom vplyvnej dynastie Rockefellerov. Dnes o tom informovala televízia CNN s tým, že Jay Rockefeller zomrel vo štvrtok vo svojom dome vo Washingtone.

lithuania.title: „Do Ruska nemôžete poslať bývalého generála NATO.“ Laššáková spochybnila Pavla ako vyjednávača aj návrat odvlečených detí na Ukrajinu
lithuania.description: Vládnu politiku voči Ukrajine a úlohu Európy pri ukončení vojny hodnotili vo štvrtkovej relácii Téma dňa na televízii ta3 europoslankyne Judita Laššáková (Smer) a Miriam Lexmann (KDH). Kým Laššáková stretnutie vlád v Ľvove vyzdvihla, Lexmann premiérovi vyčítala, že pre mier urobil málo. Reč bola aj o voľbách v USA a spore o Ústavný súd v Poľsku.

lithuania.title: Člen NATO uzavrel obranný pakt s jadrovou mocnosťou. Útok na jedného sa má týkať všetkých troch
lithuania.description: Turecko sa priblížilo k vytvoreniu nového obranného spojenectva so Saudskou Arábiou a Pakistanom. Jeho parlament schválil dohodu, podľa ktorej sa ozbrojený útok na jednu z troch krajín má považovať za útok na všetky. Nový pakt spája člena NATO s jadrovou mocnosťou a jedným z najvýznamnejších štátov Blízkeho východu. Zatiaľ čo vláda v Ankare hovorí o posilnení bezpečnosti, časť opozície varuje pred rizikom, že tureckých vojakov vtiahnu do konfliktov mimo vlastnej krajiny.

lithuania.title: Ukrajinská policie předala mafii tajné informace od rakouských kolegů
lithuania.description: Ukrajinští policisté předali zločinecké organizaci vedené Andrijem Osipovem důvěrné informace, které získali od rakouských bezpečnostních složek vyšetřujících brutální útok ve Vídni. Členové gangu měli v jedné z tamních kanceláří napadnout lidi kladivy, přičemž si celý útok natočili.

lithuania.title: Extrema stângă franceză a inclus ieșirea din NATO în programul oficial pentru alegerile prezidențiale
lithuania.description: Partidul candidatului prezidențial de extremă stângă, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, a inclus ieșirea din NATO și naționalizarea companiilor din domeniul apărării în programul său oficial, publicat vineri, scrie Politico.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte: O victorie categorică a Ucrainei sau a Rusiei este puțin probabilă. „Războiul se va încheia cu un compromis”
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, consideră că războiul dintre Rusia și Ucraina se va încheia, cel mai probabil, printr-un acord negociat, nu printr-o victorie categorică a uneia dintre părți. Oficialul a avertizat însă că Moscova va dispune în continuare de o armată numeroasă după încetarea luptelor, iar trupele ruse vor putea reprezenta o amenințare pentru alte state europene. Rutte a subliniat, totodată, că Statele Unite rămân indispensabile pentru apărarea Europei, anunță Kyiv Post.

lithuania.title: Președintele Lituaniei avertizează că Putin „se apropie tot mai mult de Articolul 5”: „Rușii se vor preface doar că negociază”
lithuania.description: Președintele Lituaniei, Gitanas Nauseda, nu consideră că un atac convențional al Rusiei asupra teritoriului NATO este probabil în acest moment, dar se așteaptă ca provocările liderului rus Vladimir Putin să continue, relatează Politico.

lithuania.title: Guvernatorul Californiei îi iartă pe toți condamnații la moarte din stat: pedepsele se transformă în închisoare pe viață
lithuania.description: Guvernatorul Californiei, Gavin Newsom, a declarat joi că va comuta pedepsele cu moartea tuturor celor 548 de deținuți condamnați în prezent la execuție în statul său, care are cel mai mare număr de condamnați la moarte din emisfera vestică, afirmând că consideră pedeapsa capitală ca fiind imorală, scrie Reuters.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu: Europa se află în pragul unei noi explozii a prețurilor. Cea mai mare contribuție o are creșterea prețurilor la energie
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, spune că „Europa se află în pragul unei noi explozii a prețurilor”, din cauza creșterii prețurilor produselor industriale. El avertizează că în perioada decembrie-martie vom avea o creștere a ratei anualizate a inflației de peste 10%.

lithuania.title: Un aliat de-ai lui Trump compară alegerile din SUA cu o „extincție” pentru republicani. „Pur și simplu au dus bătălia de ieri”
lithuania.description: Guvernatorul statului Florida, Ron DeSantis, a criticat dur starea politicii republicane după înfrângerile devastatoare suferite de partid la alegerile de la jumătatea mandatului. DeSantis a numit mai mulți factori - de la dosarele Epstein până la tranzacțiile cu acțiuni efectuate de membrii Congresului. Criticile sale vin în condițiile în care republicanii din Florida au respins „valul albastru”, în timp ce democrații din întreaga țară au preluat circumscripții care aparțineau de mult timp republicanilor și au preluat controlul asupra Congresului, scrie Politico.

lithuania.title: NATO a lansat o platformă de tip e-commerce, unde țările membre pot cumpăra sisteme antidronă. Cât costă echipamentele
lithuania.description: NATO a anunţat joi lansarea unei platforme comune destinate să le permită celor 32 de state membre să se doteze mai rapid şi mai eficient cu capacităţi antidrone, în urma creşterii numărului de incidente cu drone în Europa.

lithuania.title: Donald Trump vrea să stabilească cine e câștigătorul alegerilor în Alaska. „Nu există altă soluție echitabilă”
lithuania.description: Președintele american Donald Trump a afirmat joi, într-o postare de pe Truth Social, că voturile din Alaska pentru candidatul opoziției, Dan Sullivan, ar trebui atribuite senatorului republican în funcție, pe care îl cheamă tot Dan Sullivan. În Alaska, unde rezultatul votului nu este în cunoscut, cursa electorală a fost dominată de un scandal atribuit candidatei democrate, Mary Peltola, care este acuzată că a făcut demersuri pentru înscrierea în alegeri a unui candidat cu același nume ca al candidatului republican, pentru a-i diminua numărul de voturi.

lithuania.title: „Și-a făcut o misiune din a fi un șoc”. După doi ani de unilateralism dominator, noul Congres ar putea tempera impulsurile lui Trump
lithuania.description: Timp de doi ani, lumea a făcut față unilateralismului dominator al președintelui american Donald Trump, suportând fluctuațiile tarifelor, un război cu Iranul, agresiuni în America Latină, schimbări bruște de poziție în privința Ucrainei și o avalanșă de cereri adresate aliaților, printre care Canada, Germania și Japonia. Acum, în condițiile în care democrații au preluat controlul asupra Congresului, în timp ce aproape toți republicanii preferați de Trump au suferit înfrângeri, multe țări se întreabă la ce să se aștepte de la încă o astfel de răsturnare de situație în politica americană, notează The New York Times.

lithuania.title: Spania și Țările de Jos se luptă pentru președinția Băncii Centrale Europene / Pablo Hernández de Cos și Klaas Knot, în cursa pentru președinție după plecarea Christinei Lagarde
lithuania.description: Olanda și Spania au prezentat vineri candidații pentru președinția BCE, dat fiind că actuala președintă Christine Lagarde își va încheia mandatul pe 7 februarie, relatează Politico. lithuania.title: Franţa va asigura protecţia principalului hub de livrări occidentale către Ucraina din Polonia din ianuarie 2027
lithuania.description: Franţa va prelua sarcina de a apăra aeroportul polonez de la Rzeszow, principalul hub de livrări de ajutor occidental către Ucraina, în cadrul unei misiuni NATO, a declarat vineri ambasadorul francez la Varşovia, relatează agenția de știri Reuters, citată de Agerpres. „Începând de la 1 ianuarie, în cadrul NATO, Franţa va prelua apărarea aeriană în […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Nude blackmail of British soldier at Tapa raises security concerns
lithuania.description: A British corporal at a NATO exercise in Tapa ignored orders to remove his phone's SIM card, and was then hacked and blackmailed over nude photographs, Eesti Ekspress reported.

lithuania.title: BLOGI ⟩ BLOGI 1718. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi hoiatas Venemaa uute rünnakute eest Ukraina energiasektori vastu
lithuania.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1718. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis. 2026/ukraina-kalender

lithuania.title: Zelenskõi hoiatas Venemaa uute rünnakute eest Ukraina energiasektori vastu
lithuania.description: Ukraina president Volodõmõr Zelenskõi hoiatas eile, et Venemaa kavandab uut rünnakut riigi energiasektori vastu, ning kordas oma üleskutset Patrioti raketitõrjesüsteemide saamiseks.

lithuania.title: PIIRIPEALNE ⟩ Kes viib Norras lilli «kuldtärniga sõjamehele»?
lithuania.description: Aastakümneid tunti Finnmarkis – Norra kuningriigi kõige idapoolsemas osas –, et neil on venelastega privilegeeritud erisuhe. Ukraina sõja valguses on hakatud mõtlema, et minevik ei pruugi enam kunagi tagasi tulla.

lithuania.title: POSTIMEES UKRAINAS ⟩ Et talvel oleks sooja, elektrit ja vett, laenasid kortermaja elanikud üksteisele raha
lithuania.description: Mis saab teie majast, kui talvel kaob elekter terveks ööpäevaks? Harkivi 21-korruselise elamu elanikud on leidnud viisi, kuidas hoida pikema elektrikatkestuse ajal töös küte, veevarustus ja liftid. Ukraina korteriomanike ühenduste kogemusest võib kasu olla ka Eesti elanikele.

lithuania.title: Mihkelson: uut Teherani või Jalta lepet ei tule
lithuania.description: Kui USA president Donald Trump viitas võimalusele sõlmida Venemaaga suur kokkulepe, mis puudutab lisaks Ukraina sõja lõpetamisele ka kogu Euroopa julgeolekut, siis riigikogu väliskomisjoni esimehe Marko Mihkelsoni arvates seda ei juhtu.

lithuania.title: WATCH: Latvian Foreign Minister speaks at NATO command centre
lithuania.description: Latvia's Foreign Minister Baiba Braže was in the Netherlands on November 4th at NATO’s Allied Joint Force Command Brunssum and participated in an informal meeting of foreign ministers.

lithuania.title: Pēc republikāņu fiasko Tramps palicis bez ietekmes svirām: analītiķi brīdina, kas varētu sekot
lithuania.description: Demokrātu uzvara ASV vidustermiņa vēlēšanās varētu pavērt ceļu jaunam atbalstam Ukrainai, kas turpina aizstāvēties pret Krievijas iebrukumu, kā arī veicināt rūpīgāku ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa politikas izvērtēšanu attiecībā uz Krieviju, ceturtdien norādīja analītiķi. lithuania.title: Volodymyras Zelenskis įspėja apie naujus Rusijos smūgius Ukrainos energetikos sektoriui
lithuania.description: Ukrainos prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis penktadienio vakare įspėjo, kad Rusija planuoja naują smūgį Ukrainos energetikos sektoriui, ir dar kartą paragino suteikti priešraketinių sistemų „Patriot“.

lithuania.title: Popiežius Leonas XIV atvyko į Urugvajų, pradėdamas 12 dienų kelionę po Pietų Ameriką
lithuania.description: Popiežius Leonas XIV penktadienį atvyko į Urugvajų, pradėdamas intensyvią 12 dienų kelionę po Pietų Ameriką, praėjus trims savaitėms po jam dėl plaučių vėžio atliktos operacijos, pranešė popiežiaus lėktuve buvę naujienų agentūros AFP žurnalistai.

lithuania.title: Ramūs ir monotoniški orai užsitęs
lithuania.description: Šiandien toliau orus lems tas pats anticiklonas, kurio įtaka mūsų regione pamažu mažės. Danguje atsiras tankesnių debesų, tačiau lietaus jie neatneš. Vėjas pūs stiprokai, bus vakarinių krypčių. Aukščiausia temperatūra pasiskirstys tarp 5–10 laipsnių šilumos.

lithuania.title: Donaldas Trumpas naujuoju savo administracijos vadovu paskyrė lojalistą Stepheną Millerį
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas Stepheną Millerį penktadienį paskyrė naujuoju savo administracijos vadovu, paaukštindamas savo griežtos migracijos politikos kūrėją po to, kai Respublikonų partija JAV kadencijos vidurio rinkimuose patyrė skaudų pralaimėjimą.

lithuania.title: Rusijos „Vyriškos valstybės“ įkūrėjas neigia, kad grupuotė yra susijusi su grasinimais bombomis
lithuania.description: „Vyriškos valstybės“ – 2021 metais dėl „ekstremizmo“uždrausto radikalaus mizoginiško judėjimo Rusijoje – įkūrėjas penktadienį paneigė, kad grupuotė yra kaip nors susijusi su melagingais grasinimais susprogdinti bombas Europoje.

lithuania.title: Paragvajaus Senatas pradėjo prezidento apkaltos procesą
lithuania.description: Paragvajaus Senate penktadienį prasidėjo šalies prezidento Santiago Penos (Santjago Penjos) apkaltos procesas.

lithuania.title: Medvedevas prakalbo apie Muską ir Ukrainą
lithuania.description: Rusijos Saugumo Tarybos pirmininko pavaduotojas Dmitrijus Medvedevas savo „Telegram“ kanale parašė, kad „SpaceX“ įkūrėjo Elono Musko sprendimas po Rusijos invazijos suteikti Ukrainai palydovinį ryšį „Starlink“ amerikiečių verslininką pavertė karo dalyviu.
